items.title: Jawhar Jordan: Sidelined due to hip injury
items.body_text: Jordan is dealing with a hip flexor strain and will be sidelined for "roughly a week," Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Expected back soon
items.body_text: Price (lower body) didn't practice Saturday, but coach Mike Macdonald said the rookie running back should be back in a matter of days, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Laremy Tunsil: Diagnosed with torn triceps
items.body_text: Tunsil tore his triceps during practice Saturday and is expected to need surgery, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ty Johnson: Departs practice with knee injury
items.body_text: Johnson left practice early Saturday due to an apparent right knee injury, Matt Parrino of NYup.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Dealing with lower-body soreness
items.body_text: Price didn't practice Friday due to "lower-body soreness," Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
